column1: # The words localized documents write around a version, read by scripts/check-release-version.sh:
# data, so that script's source stays in US English. One entry per line, two fields separated by a
# tab: the name the checker reads it by and its value. A row value is a regular expression (most are
# an alternation of words) that the row named in the checker inserts into its pattern as written; a
# next-release value is the sentence start the selftest plants in that locale's README. The checker
# refuses the file whole (exit 2) when it cannot be read, a line is not name<TAB>value, a name
# repeats, a value does not compile or matches the empty string, or a name it reads is missing.
